Hi all —

Thanks for the heads-up. I can take the technical portion. A few things I'll need in advance to size dedicated pools accurately:
- Expected steady-state tokens/day and expected peak 5m QPS (they included monthly volumes but if you have 5m and 1m QPS estimates that helps)
- Typical prompt vs. completion token ratio
- Target tail latency SLA (95th/99th percentiles)

From the forecast I eyeballed, they look like they'd benefit from a medium dedicated pool (8x A100-equivalent) with KV caching enabled — that gives a good balance of tail latency and cost. I'll attach our capacity options and a quick back-of-envelope sizing doc.

Attachments: redwood_capacity_options.pdf

I'll plan for 09:30–11:00 PT on Wed 2026-03-10. If procurement only needs the first 30 minutes, we can have procurement leave after 10:00 PT and continue SE deep-dive with Eng and Product.

Cheers,
